string.text: Chamber adjustment
Eliminating backlash makes it possible to improve sealing and achieve higher shooting accuracy.
Barrel with thread for silencer
Replacing the barrel with an elongated one, with a thread intended for installing a muffler.
Refinement of the extractor
Allows you to reduce the number of delays associated with the sticking of cartridges ejected from the pistol after firing.
Heavy Duty Parts
New parts made from modern refractory alloys have higher strength, which slows down the wear of the weapon and has a beneficial effect on its reliability.
Lightweight parts
Replacing standard weapon parts with lightweight analogues made from modern alloys makes it possible to reduce the weight of weapons.
USM calibration
Individual fitting and balancing of standard parts of the firing mechanism allows for higher shooting accuracy while reducing recoil.
Lightweight handle
Allows you to slightly reduce the weight of the weapon.
Enlarged magazine
Replacing a standard magazine with a modern analogue, which, due to its compacted layout, has a slightly larger capacity.
Protective coating
Applying a protective coating to weapon parts increases its service life.
Forced return mechanism
Allows the shooter to fire at a higher rate.Unfortunately, this causes the weapon to wear out a little faster.
Recoil compensation system
Placement inside the weapon of a complex Swiss-made mechanism that moves in antiphase with the bolt and reduces the recoil felt after shots.
Forcing USM
Reconfiguring the trigger and modifying some of its parts allows the shooter to fire at a higher rate.Unfortunately, this causes the weapon to wear out a little faster.
Soft trigger trigger
Allows you to reduce recoil, facilitating more accurate shooting.
Barrel with modified rifling pitch
Changing the pitch of the rifling in the bore of a weapon allows you to increase the initial speed of the bullet and reduce the spread of hits when firing.
Barrel adjustment
Allows you to reduce the spread of bullets when firing a weapon, which increases the accuracy and accuracy of fire.
Shot destabilizer

A cunning system that forces a bullet to enter the victim’s body at an arbitrary angle, forming a natural mess instead of a clearly defined wound channel.Because of this, the accuracy and accuracy of the weapon's combat are somewhat reduced, but these shortcomings are more than compensated for by the damage the victim receives.
Shutter Balancing
Balancing the bolt group parts reduces the barrel moving away from the line of sight when firing and reduces felt recoil.
Tritium inserts
Installing luminous inserts in sights allows you to increase the speed of aiming and the convenience of firing in the dark.
